summary:
SpaceX is an interactive online tool that enables people to detect and analyze environmental trends on Earth through the use of Earth observation data. This application is developed to solve the problem of detecting patterns within complicated environmental datasets by incorporating environment data exploration, trend analysis, and visualization capabilities.

The application uses the Mann-Kendall test and Sen's slope estimation algorithms to detect trends in the environmental variable of interest as well as to assess their rate of change. SpaceX provides several useful features like interactive world map, trend analysis dashboard, geographical exploration, and AI-powered insights, thus simplifying the process of analyzing and comprehending complex environmental data.

SpaceX helps in raising the environmental awareness, scientific research and data-driven understanding of our changing planet.

**Our mission is to simplify Earth data and make our changing planet understandable.**
details:
SpaceX

Be An Earth System Trend Detective!

SpaceX is an environmental data analysis project developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project focuses on exploring changes in Earth's systems using environmental data, statistical analysis, AI-based techniques, and interactive visualizations.

1. What Does Our Project Do?

SpaceX aims to help users identify and understand environmental trends across different geographical regions.

Earth observation data provides valuable information about temperature, precipitation, soil moisture, vegetation, sea level, and atmospheric conditions. However, understanding long-term environmental changes from large datasets can be challenging.

Our project aims to simplify this process by helping users explore environmental information, identify patterns, analyze trends, and understand possible environmental changes.

2. How Does It Work?

Our proposed workflow consists of six stages:

  1. NASA Earth Data: Explore relevant Earth observation data from suitable sources.
  2. Data Cleaning: Organize and prepare environmental data for analysis.
  3. Trend Detection: Identify increasing, decreasing, or changing patterns over time.
  4. AI and Statistical Analysis: Apply suitable analytical techniques to examine environmental trends.
  5. Visualization: Present information through interactive maps, graphs, charts, and dashboards.
  6. Environmental Insights: Help users understand observed patterns and their potential significance.

3. Benefits and Intended Impact

Our project aims to make environmental data easier to explore and understand.

Potential benefits include:

  • Helping users understand long-term environmental changes.
  • Identifying patterns in environmental variables.
  • Making complex Earth observation data easier to interpret.
  • Supporting environmental education and scientific exploration.
  • Encouraging data-driven awareness about our changing planet.

Our intended impact is to make environmental information more accessible and help people better understand changes happening across Earth's systems.

4. Technologies and Tools Used

The project uses web development and data analysis technologies, including:

  • React.js – Interactive user interface.
  • JavaScript – Application logic and functionality.
  • HTML and CSS – Web structure and styling.
  • Vite – Development and build tool.
  • Recharts – Data visualization and charts.
  • Vercel – Web application deployment.
  • NASA Earth observation data sources – Environmental data exploration.
  • Statistical and AI-based methods – Environmental trend analysis and interpretation.

5. Creativity and Innovation

The creative idea behind SpaceX is to bring environmental data exploration, trend detection, statistical analysis, AI-based interpretation, and interactive visualization together in one platform.

Instead of presenting environmental data as isolated numbers, our project focuses on discovering patterns and making environmental changes easier to understand.

The platform aims to connect geographical exploration with time-based analysis, helping users investigate what is changing and where changes are occurring.

6. Factors Considered by Our Team

During the project design and development, our team considered:

  • Availability and reliability of environmental data.
  • Data quality and missing observations.
  • Geographical and time-based relevance.
  • Reliability of statistical analysis.
  • Clarity of graphs and visualizations.
  • Ease of use and accessibility.
  • Responsible interpretation of environmental trends.

We recognize that observed trends do not automatically explain their causes. Results must be interpreted according to the selected dataset, time period, and analytical limitations.

7. Our Vision

Our vision is to transform Earth observation data into meaningful environmental insights and make it easier for people to explore, analyze, and understand our changing planet.

Team SpaceX – Exploring Earth, Understanding Change.
